verses.text: To the People of Thamud, was sent their brother Saleh (a.s). A clear proof was given to them through the she-camel. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 10)
They were made successors after the People of Ad and were capable of building mansions in the valleys and carving out homes in the mountains. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 10)

They hamstrung the she camel and challenged Saleh (a.s) to bring down the scourge. Allah saved Saleh a.s and an earthquake overtook them and they became lifeless bodies in their homes, with their faces down. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 10)
To the people of Thamud, Allah sent their brother Saleh (a.s). (Surah Hud : Section 6)
Saleh (a.s) reasoned with them to worship only one Allah and to turn to Him in repentance. (Surah Hud : Section 6)
The people of Thamud said: “O Saleh! Till now you were the one in whom we had great expectations! Would you now forbid us the worship of what our forefathers worshipped. (Surah Hud : Section 6)
A she camel was sent miraculously as a sign and a test to the people, but they hamstrung her (and killed her). (Surah Hud : Section 6)
Allah gave them 3 days to enjoy on the earth. (Surah Hud : Section 6)
Allah saved Saleh and those who believed with him, through a special mercy. A mighty blast overtook the wrongdoers and they lay dead in the morning, faces down. (Surah Hud : Section 6)
Mention is made of the people of Thamud and their brother Saleh (a.s). (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 8)

Saleh (a.s) warned his people to fear Allah and not to follow the extravagant who cause corruption in the land and reform nothing. But the people said that he was bewitched and called for a sign to be brought forth. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 8)

Saleh (a.s) said: “Well, here is the she-camel! (the sign that you asked for). She shall have her share of water as you all have yours, each drinking on an alternative appointed day. Do not touch her with evil, lest the punishment of a dreadful Day may overtake you”. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 8)

Yet, the people hamstrung her, and then they became full of regrets. The punishment overtook them completely. Surely in this story is a great lesson, but most of these people do not learn and become believers. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 8)

To the People of Thamud, Allah had sent their brother Saleh (a.s) who said to them: “Worship Allah”. There were 9 ringleaders in the city and they plotted to kill Saleh and his family. But Allah devised a counter plan which they did not perceive. (Surah An-Naml : Section 4)
Just see what was the outcome of their plot! Allah annihilated them completely together with all their people. (Surah An-Naml : Section 4)

Allah destroyed the people of Ad and Thamud. Shaitaan had made their foul deeds fair-seeming to them and diverted them from the Right Way, though they were intelligent people. (Surah Al-Ankabut : Section 4)

Reminder of the people of Thamud, when Allah sent to them the she-camel in a miraculous way. They were instructed to divide the water between the Thamudites and the she-camel in turns. (Surah Al- Qamar : Section 2)
But they struck the she camel and killed her. Allah let loose on them a mighty blast and they became like trampled twigs. (Surah Al- Qamar : Section 2)
Allah has indeed made the Quran very easy to read and remember, so is there any who would take admonition. (Surah Al-Qamar : Section 2)
Reminder of the people of Thamud and how they denied the truth. The she-camel was sent to them (as a sign) but they hamstrung her. (Surah Ash-Shams)
Therefore, for that crime, Allah let loose His scourge upon them and levelled them to the ground. (Surah Ash-Shams)
For He (Allah) has no fear of its consequences. (Surah Ash-Shams)
